mechanism: Azithromycin may increase gastric motility and alter levodopa absorption, and both drugs can affect CNS function; azithromycin also has weak QT-prolongation potential which may be relevant in parkinsonian patients with cardiac comorbidities.
action: Monitor for changes in Parkinson's symptom control; consider timing azithromycin doses away from carbidopa-levodopa if GI effects emerge; assess cardiac status before azithromycin use.
